outcome: Prevalence of antiseizure drug use during pregnancy
Prevalence of antiseizure drug use in women of childbearing age
cohort: The study included two cohorts: 387,418 weighted pregnancies leading to a delivery, and 2,781,151 weighted women aged 15-45 years insured with Helsana for at least one year between 2014 and 2018.
finding: The study found that valproate was dispensed to 1.9/10,000 women during pregnancy and to 25/10,000 women of childbearing age, suggesting its use in the latter group in Switzerland might be higher than clinically needed despite a decreasing trend.
